subject: Incident response plan request, sanitized postmortem, and redaction checklist
messages:
From: Samira Khan <samira.khan@cloudbridge.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
Cc: security@cloudbridge.com
Date: Fri, 23 Jun 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Incident notification: brief telemetry gap affecting API key audit

Evelyn,

Quick note from CloudBridge security — we observed a short telemetry gap impacting API key rotation events for a subset of requests to your hosted endpoint (region: us-west-2) between 02:12 and 02:17 UTC on 2028-06-23. No confirmed data exfiltration on our side, but our SIEM flagged missing rotation events which prevents us completing our audit.

Could you please:
- Confirm you have an incident response plan (IRP) we can reference for this type of telemetry gap.
- Provide a sanitized/summarized postmortem we can use in our audit (redact PII and internal IPs).
- Share the specific telemetry extract (rotation events, token issuance/refresh, request ids) and a short summary of mitigations taken.

We appreciate a rapid turnaround — our compliance window for this quarter's audit request is next Friday. If you prefer a short call, I can coordinate.

Thanks,
Samira Khan
Head of Security, CloudBridge
samira.khan@cloudbridge.com
+1 415-555-0219

[attachment: "cb_alert_20280623.png" (image/png) referenced in SIEM]

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
To: Samira Khan <samira.khan@cloudbridge.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 23 Jun 2028 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Incident notification: brief telemetry gap affecting API key audit

Samira — thanks for the heads up and the SIEM screenshot. We're looking into the ingestion gap now.

Immediate plan:
- Acknowledged. We'll produce a sanitized IRP extract and a short postmortem summary by EOD Monday (our target).
- We'll include the requested telemetry extract with PII/internal-host redaction and a short mitigation timeline (what we rotated, rollbacks, and config changes).
- Marissa will lead the evidence package and handle redaction; Jonas will confirm any implications for our hosted customers.

One ask: do you have any specific redaction rules your auditors require (e.g., fully redact IPs vs. pseudonymize request IDs)? If you can share a quick checklist we will align the deliverables.

Proposed immediate deliverables:
1) Short postmortem (sanitized) — PDF.
2) Telemetry extract (CSV) — redacted.
3) Audit log snippet showing sequence of rotation events — text file.
4) Token rotation summary (actions taken, start/finish times) — doc.

If you prefer a 30-minute sync Monday morning to walk through artifacts, we're available 09:00-11:00 PT.

Best,
Evelyn Hart
Security Operations Manager
Redwood Inference
evelyn_hart@redwood.ai

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Samira Khan <samira.khan@cloudbridge.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 24 Jun 2028 15:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Incident notification: brief telemetry gap affecting API key audit

Hi Samira / Evelyn — attaching the initial sanitized evidence package for your audit window. Below is a short executive summary; full sanitized artifacts attached.

Executive summary (sanitized):
- Incident window: 2028-06-23 02:12:00 — 02:17:10 UTC.
- Root cause: transient ingestion backlog in our regionally-scoped telemetry pipeline; a downstream enrichment job retried and temporarily delayed event writes for rotation confirmation records. This caused rotation confirmation rows to be delayed or omitted from the primary index for ~5 minutes.
- Impact: Rotation confirmation events were delayed for a small cohort of tokens tied to a scheduled bulk rotation job. No evidence of token theft or unauthorized access.
- Mitigation: We replayed the enrichment job, re-ingested missing events, and implemented a circuit-breaker to prevent retries from starving the write queue. Token rotation for affected keys was re-issued and verified by 02:48 UTC.

Deliverables attached (sanitized):
- redwood_irp_sanitized_v2.pdf — excerpted IRP section for telemetry gaps (redacted internal hostnames).
- telemetry_extract_20280623_redacted.csv — rotation event rows with request IDs pseudonymized and IPs redacted.
- audit_log_snippet.txt — illustrative sequence showing missing vs. restored records (timestamps preserved).
- token_rotation_summary.docx — short runbook output indicating rotation timeline and verification checks.

Redaction notes:
- Internal IP addresses removed.
- Customer identifiers replaced with stable pseudonyms (CB-CUST-###).
- Full path names and internal service hostnames masked per our standard SOC2 redaction policy.

If you need additional fields (e.g., full driver-level telemetry or S3 object keys), we can provide them under an NDA or through a secure transfer; let us know.

Links:  https://drive.google.com/open?id=1aBcDeFghIRPexample (read-only, redacted set)
HubSpot record: https://hubspot.com/records/CB-12458

Regards,
Marissa Cole
Sr. Manager, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai

Attachments: redwood_irp_sanitized_v2.pdf (application/pdf), telemetry_extract_20280623_redacted.csv (text/csv), audit_log_snippet.txt (text/plain), token_rotation_summary.docx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document)

From: Samira Khan <samira.khan@cloudbridge.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
Cc: security@cloudbridge.com
Date: Sun, 25 Jun 2028 08:14:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Incident notification: brief telemetry gap affecting API key audit

Marissa / Evelyn — thank you, received the materials and the Drive link. Quick follow-up:
- The redaction approach looks good; our auditors prefer pseudonymized IDs (that matches your package).
- Could you also provide a short CAIQ mapping (control IDs touched + where the evidence lives) so I can slot this into our SIG/CAIQ crosswalk? A 1-page table is fine.
- Also confirm the timestamp accuracy for the rotation verification step (you list 02:48 UTC in the summary). If that's final, we'll mark the incident as "contained" in our tracker.

If possible, could you drop the CAIQ mapping by EOD Monday? Appreciate the quick turnaround.

Best,
Samira Khan
Head of Security, CloudBridge
